title: Java Architect
description:
**Company Description**

Incede Technologies Private Limited is a product engineering company founded by seasoned banking technology professionals with deep experience in the BFSI sector. The organization focuses on building innovative, scalable, and high-quality software products and solutions for financial services. Incede aims to transform how financial institutions operate by delivering robust technology that supports growth and adaptability in a rapidly changing market. The company is dedicated to providing cutting-edge yet cost-effective solutions that help partners remain competitive and future-ready. Team members collaborate closely with clients to address complex business challenges through modern technology architectures and practices.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Java Architect role based in Kochi. The Java Architect will design and oversee end-to-end application architectures, with an emphasis on scalable, secure, and maintainable Java-based solutions. Daily responsibilities include defining technical standards, selecting appropriate frameworks, and guiding implementation of microservices and Jakarta EE-based applications. The role involves collaborating with product owners and development teams to translate business requirements into technical designs, performing code and design reviews, and resolving complex technical issues. The Java Architect will also mentor engineers, optimize system performance, and ensure alignment with best practices and design patterns across projects.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Java-based Software Development skills, including experience building enterprise applications and services.
* Proficiency in Architecture and system design, with the ability to define scalable, secure, and modular solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Microservices design and implementation, including service decomposition and integration.
* Knowledge of Jakarta EE and related frameworks for building robust, transactional, and distributed applications.
* Applied understanding of Design Patterns and best practices in object-oriented and distributed system design.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in BFSI or financial services domains is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor developers, and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to producing high-quality, well-tested software.

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Solution Development:

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
+ Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
+ Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
+ Integration and Deployment:

* API Development:

+ Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
+ Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
+ Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
  
  
This is a technology-first, hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
  
  
**Core Requirements**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale eCommerce or digital-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery leader for customer and internal stakeholders, driving technical discussions, resolving escalations, influencing solution decisions, and building stakeholder confidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Proven experience leading distributed engineering teams, including offshore teams, and owning complex delivery from estimation through deployment and production stabilization.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional teams, product & platform teams, and external vendors or partners involved in the client engagement.

* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology

**About the Role**

Cyncly is establishing a dedicated AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Kochi, India, to build, fine-tune, and operationalize on-premises large language models across Cyncly's product suite. The AI/ML Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for training pipelines, fine-tuning domain-specific models, embeddings infrastructure, and integrating AI across five LLM use cases: product knowledge search, document intelligence, Service Desk ticket classification and resolution drafting, developer copilot assistance, and conversational product configuration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LLM Fine-Tuning & Training Pipelines**

* Implement and maintain supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF pipelines for Cyncly domain-specific models, leveraging proprietary product catalogue, documentation, and support data.
* Apply LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning via Hugging Face PEFT; manage model checkpointing, hyperparameter tuning, and training run tracking. Work with quantised models (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) to optimise inference on GPU.
* Maintain reproducible experiments, model versioning, and artefact management using MLflow or Weights & Biases; collaborate with Data Engineering to curate and version domain datasets with PII scrubbing and data-quality checks.

**Embeddings Infrastructure & Semantic Search**

* Develop and optimise embedding pipelines using models such as BGE-M3 and E5-large; manage vector database ingestion, indexing strategies, and retrieval quality for Cyncly's product catalogues and documentation.
* Design, benchmark, and maintain vector database deployments (Qdrant, Weaviate, or equivalent), including index configuration, filtering strategies, and scalability planning.
* Implement retrieval quality metrics (MRR, NDCG, recall@k), run A/B evaluations of embedding model upgrades, and build hybrid search pipelines combining dense vector retrieval with BM25 sparse search to maximise product discovery accuracy.

**RAG Architecture & Use Case Integration**

* Design and implement RAG layers for Cyncly's five LLM use cases, ensuring context relevance, faithfulness, and latency targets; integrate MCP connectors to expose internal data sources and product APIs to the LLM inference layer.
* Build and maintain the developer copilot integration using Continue.dev and custom language-server extensions; implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and guardrail layers across all inference paths.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering squads to expose AI capabilities through REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs and integrate them into Cyncly's product surfaces.

**Model Evaluation & Quality Assurance**

* Write model evaluation harnesses and regression test suites; track and report quality metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, faithfulness score, hallucination rate, answer relevance) per deployed model and use case.
* Partner with the AI/ML QA team to design human evaluation workflows and validate model outputs before production release; maintain a model leaderboard and evaluation artefacts for all active models enabling data-driven decisions on upgrades and rollbacks.
* Implement continuous evaluation pipelines triggered on model updates, ensuring quality regressions are detected before reaching production.

**Inference Infrastructure & Observability**

* Deploy and manage LLM inference using vLLM or Text Generation Inference (TGI) on Cyncly's on-premises GPU infrastructure, targeting production-grade throughput and latency SLAs.
* Instrument inference latency, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilisation, and cost metrics; surface results to operational dashboards for the AI leadership team; participate in on-call rotation and incident response for model-serving issues.
* Contribute to the containerisation and orchestration of AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployments are reproducible, scalable, and integrated with Cyncly's CI/CD pipelines.

**Knowledge Graphs & Advanced Data Pipelines**

* Contribute to Cyncly's product knowledge graph (Neo4j) — entity-extraction pipelines, schema design, and graph query integration with RAG; build NLP pipelines to enrich product and document knowledge.
* Explore and prototype agentic AI patterns (tool use, multi-step reasoning) for complex information retrieval and action execution use cases.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on software and/or AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 2 years working directly with large language models or transformer-based systems.
* Strong Python programming skills; proficiency with PyTorch or JAX training ecosystems, and Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT (LoRA, QLoRA), and model evaluation frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, Chroma, or equivalent), including indexing, filtering, and retrieval optimisation; solid understanding of embedding models, semantic search quality metrics, and RAG architecture patterns.
* Experience building and consuming REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs; solid understanding of prompt engineering best practices including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and structured outputs.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and experience working within CI/CD pipelines.

**Mandatory Technical Experience**

* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Proficiency in Python with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, Accelerate, Evaluate).
* **Fine-Tuning & Quantisation:**
  Experience with LoRA, QLoRA, and quantisation techniques (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) for on-premises model deployment.
* **Inference Serving:**
  Hands-on experience with vLLM, Text Generation Inference (TGI), or Ollama for production LLM serving.
* **Vector Databases & RAG:**
  Practical experience designing and querying vector databases; proficiency in retrieval evaluation and hybrid search implementations.
* **Experiment Tracking & Evaluation:**
  MLflow, Weights & Biases, or LangSmith for experiment tracking and LLM observability; strong background in model evaluation — automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, RAGAS), human evaluation, and regression testing.
* **Infrastructure & DevOps:**
  Experience with Docker and Kubernetes; ability to write Dockerfiles, Helm charts, and CI/CD pipeline configurations.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Cypher/SPARQL) for entity extraction and graph-augmented retrieval; experience integrating helpdesk or ticketing platforms (e.g. Zendesk APIs) for NLP-driven classification and resolution drafting.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) or MCP connector development; experience with developer tooling integrations such as Continue.dev, GitHub Copilot extensions, or custom LSP implementations.
* Open-source contributions to ML projects, LLM tooling, or evaluation frameworks; experience with multi-modal or vision-language models (VLMs) for product image understanding.

**Competency Requirements**

* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Writes clean, well-tested Python code; comfortable with code reviews, Git workflows, and contributing to shared ML infrastructure libraries.
* **Analytical & Experimental Mindset:**
  Designs experiments with clear hypotheses, tracks results rigorously, and uses evaluation data to make evidence-based model decisions.
* **Collaboration & Communication:**
  Works effectively with Data Engineers, QA, Product, and Platform teams; communicates ML concepts clearly to non-specialist stakeholders.
* **Ownership & Initiative:**
  Able to take ownership of a workstream, manage ambiguity in early-stage AI projects, and deliver iterative results in a fast-moving AI programme.

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

title: Staff Engineer-UI
description:

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.

* Build features in Angular 21 using Signals, standalone components, and zoneless change detection
* Dig into older code, understand it, and refactor it into something maintainable

* Build components that look and work great on both mobile and desktop using TailwindCSS and Sass

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master of Computer Applications.

* Influence a positive team culture: raising the bar on quality, documentation, and shared ownership
* Define and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation

title: Software Verification & Testing Lead
description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.
* Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation.
* Strong experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.
* Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and database testing.
* Experience preparing test plans, test cases, test execution reports, and requirement traceability matrices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills.

‍
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Software Verification & Validation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle.
* Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.
* Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation.
* Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance.
* Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams.

Test Automation & Technical Testing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing.
* Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms.
* Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization.
* Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

Medical Device Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards.
* Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices.
* Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions.
* Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation.
* Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements.

Team Leadership & Coordination
  
  

* Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers.
* Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones.
* Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams.
* Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* **Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use**
  .
* Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.
* Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain.
* **Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD.**
* A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice.

**What We Offer**

* A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on.
* The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day.
* A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously.
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

* Expertise in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering.

* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.

EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. **The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.

* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.

title: Lead Salesforce
description:

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.

**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.

* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**

+ Service Cloud

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.Roles And ResponsibilitiesDesign end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications. Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations. Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps. Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments. Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses. Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.

**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**

**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.

* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.

* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
